title: North Korea unveils its first AI chatbot! 🇰🇵
body: North Korea unveils its first AI chatbot! 🇰🇵

North Korea appeared this week showcasing what looks like its first AI chatbot, called "AI Service System 1.0, Fountain of Wisdom". The system was shown at a national exhibition in Pyongyang last October, appeared on state television on Monday, and can answer science and technology questions in Korean or English and provide translations.

Notably, the screen warns users against asking social or political questions, and there appears to be a filter that screens questions before they reach the engine. Experts doubt the model was built from scratch there, and suspect it runs on an open-weights model from an American or Chinese lab, and that the country's lack of large data centers could hold back the deployment of more advanced models.
Does it surprise you that a closed country is showcasing its own chatbot? 🤔
